method: Separate script: generative enumeration of tower arrangements (no constraint checker), per-position set lookups over the raw thesis arrays for legality/coverage/parity/entropy, recomputation of conditional entropies, total correlation and affine dimensions from the retained frequency table and legal-state array; negative controls: column-permuted legal states under the retained checker copy, and zero total correlation for an independent pair.
limitations: Same author and session wrote run and audit (not independent replication). The I3D dimension estimates are exploratory and not re-derived here.
